verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval raharaas kar gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat paragaasee|

en.bdb: By remaining in and around the lotus feet, the gurmukh receives the light of the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਮਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi lekh alekh amar abinaasee|

en.bdb: Worshipping the feet and becoming the dust of the feet one becomes detached , immortal and indestructible .

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਆਚਮਨ ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਖਲਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: kar charanodhak aachaman aadh biaadh upaadh khalaasee|

en.bdb: Drinking the ash of the feet of gurmukhs, freedom from all physical mental and spiritual ailments is attained.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat aap gavaiaa maiaa a(n)dhar karan udhaasee|

en.bdb: Through the wisdom of the Guru they lose, their ego and do not get absorbed in maya.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸਚਖੰਡਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat livaleen hoi nira(n)kaar sachakha(n)dd nivaasee|

en.bdb: Absorbing their consciousness in the word, they reside in the true abode (holy congregation) of the formless one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਗੁਰਦਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: abigat gat agaadh bodh akath kathaa acharaj gurdhaasee|

en.bdb: The tale of the servants of the Lord is unfathomable ineffable and Manifest.
Remaining indifferent to hopes is the pleasure fruit of the Gurmukhs.
